articles.title: Brandon McNulty Pulls Off a Miracle to Win Cycling's World Title
articles.summary: American cyclist Brandon McNulty won the elite road race world championship in Montreal, becoming the first American to do so since 1993. He attacked with 33 km to go and held on to win by 13 seconds.

articles.title: This 18-Year-Old Invented a Plastic That Eats Microplastics
articles.summary: Irish teen Arya Satheesh created Eco Purge, a plant-based plastic that breaks down microplastics in soil and water. Her invention won a European science prize and $12,500.

articles.title: A 13-Year-Old Just Swam Faster Than Almost Anyone on Earth
articles.summary: Yu Zidi is only 13, but she just won her third gold medal at the Asian Games in Japan. She swam the 400m medley in 4:28.56 — a brand-new Games record, nearly 4.5 seconds faster than the old one.
